procedures.title: Installing Anchor Shackle
steps: Select largest shackle size that fits through chain end-link
Loop shackle head through shank shackle attachment point
Fasten pin through end link in chain
Seize pin with two turns of stainless steel or Monel seizing wire
procedures.expected_outcome: Secure connection between anchor and rode

procedures.title: Installing Anchor Swivel
steps: Ensure swivel is rated to chain breaking strength
Install few links of chain between swivel and anchor
Verify swivel can rotate properly
Confirm swivel cannot be subjected to veering load
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly functioning swivel installation

procedures.title: Launching Anchor from Bow Roller
steps: Release anchor from secured position
Allow anchor to slide forward off roller
If anchor doesn't self-launch, check roller diameter
Adjust resting angle if needed
Reduce suspended chain length if needed
procedures.expected_outcome: Smooth self-launching of anchor

procedures.title: Recovering Anchor to Bow Roller
steps: Begin anchor retrieval
Monitor anchor orientation as it approaches roller
Guide anchor onto roller in correct orientation
Allow self-righting if upside down but maintain control
Secure anchor in final position
procedures.expected_outcome: Anchor safely stored on bow roller

procedures.title: Anchor Selection and Verification
preconditions: Purchase of Rocna Original, Mk II, or Vulcan anchor
steps: Identify anchor model (Original, Mk II, or Vulcan)
Verify presence of key components: shank, fluke, roll-bar, shackle attachment point
Confirm presence of I+V™ Profile on shank
Check for tandem anchor attachment points
Verify buoyed retrieval line attachment point
Inspect roll-bar or roll-foil™ depending on model
procedures.expected_outcome: Confirmed authentic Rocna anchor with all features present

procedures.title: Anchor Component Inspection
steps: Check shackle/rode attachment point for wear
Inspect fluke condition including toe and heel
Verify roll-bar or roll-foil™ integrity
Check lashing point condition
Inspect breather holes for galvanizing
Verify skid condition
Check V-bulb™ integrity
procedures.expected_outcome: All components verified in good working condition

procedures.title: Anchor Feature Verification
steps: Verify universal-function design for multiple seabed types
Check fluke area size and concave geometry
Inspect roll-out resistance features
Verify bow stowage fit
Check shank and load-bearing component strength
Confirm absence of moving parts
procedures.expected_outcome: All design features verified present and functional

procedures.title: Basic Anchor Setting Procedure
preconditions: Anchor must be properly mounted on bow
Boat must be in suitable anchoring location
steps: Allow anchor to achieve correct preliminary setting attitude (on its side)
Let anchor weight be supported between skids, end of shank, and chisel-tip of blade
Apply gentle reverse thrust to create pull on anchor rode
Wait for anchor to roll toward upright position and bury itself
Avoid reversing boat too quickly to prevent equipment damage
procedures.expected_outcome: Anchor should set within one anchor's length of landing point

procedures.title: Roll-Bar/Roll-Foil Function Check
preconditions: Anchor must be accessible for inspection
steps: Verify roll-bar/roll-foil is intact and properly attached
Check that roll-bar/roll-foil allows anchor to achieve side orientation
Confirm roll-bar reinforces heel of fluke
For Mk II: Inspect varying profiles along roll-foil width
procedures.expected_outcome: Roll-bar/roll-foil enables proper self-righting and reinforcement

procedures.title: Vulcan Roll-Palm Inspection
preconditions: Vulcan anchor must be accessible for inspection
steps: Check roll-palm attachment and condition
Verify roll-palm works with shank shape for self-righting
Inspect ballast on underside of fluke
Confirm roll-palm reinforces heel section of fluke
procedures.expected_outcome: Roll-palm system enables proper self-righting and reinforcement

procedures.title: Anchor Load Stability Check
preconditions: Anchor must be set in seabed
steps: Apply normal working load to set anchor
Verify anchor maintains upright attitude
Test anchor stability under veering loads if possible
Monitor anchor position during tide changes
procedures.expected_outcome: Anchor remains stable and embedded under varying load conditions

procedures.title: Using a Buoyed Retrieval Line - Rocna Original and Mk II
preconditions: Anchor may be fouled or difficult to retrieve normally
steps: Attach line by shackle to the buoyed retrieval line attachment point
Ensure line remains outside the roll-bar or roll-foil
Use non-floating rope slightly longer than water depth at high tide
If normal retrieval fails, pick up buoy and lift anchor backward using retrieval line
procedures.expected_outcome: Successfully retrieve fouled anchor

procedures.title: Using a Buoyed Retrieval Line - Vulcan
preconditions: Anchor may be fouled or difficult to retrieve normally
steps: Feed line through from the top
Tie figure-of-8 knot in line end to secure
Use non-floating rope slightly longer than water depth at high tide
If normal retrieval fails, pick up buoy and lift anchor backward using retrieval line
procedures.expected_outcome: Successfully retrieve fouled anchor

procedures.title: Setting Up Tandem Anchor Configuration
preconditions: Storm conditions requiring additional holding power
steps: Set second anchor about one boat-length ahead of primary anchor
Use chain rode (not rope) for second anchor
Run rode over top of main anchor fluke and through roll-bar
Attach tandem anchor chain directly to tandem attachment point
procedures.expected_outcome: Increased holding power in extreme conditions

procedures.title: Securing Anchor When Underway
steps: Pull anchor home securely on bow roller
Hold anchor tightly back in correct roller position
Use alternative tensioning system on rode near anchor (not windlass)
Optionally lash anchor with rope using dedicated lashing point
For additional security, use tandem anchor attachment point for lashing
procedures.expected_outcome: Anchor secured safely while underway

procedures.title: Basic Anchor Deployment
steps: Drop anchor with boat stationary or drifting back
Let rode out consistently as vessel drifts back
Avoid snubbing until at least 3x water depth is paid out
Avoid piling chain on top of anchor
Maintain minimum 3:1 ratio of rode-length to depth
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly deployed anchor ready for setting

procedures.title: Setting the Anchor
steps: In wind conditions: Allow bow to wipe off naturally
In calm conditions: Motor backward slowly
Watch for sudden take-up due to quick setting
Adjust scope to 5:1 for normal conditions
Increase scope up to 8:1 for bad weather
procedures.expected_outcome: Securely set anchor

procedures.title: Anchoring in Rocky Areas
steps: Attach retrieval line before deployment
Deploy anchor with extra caution
Monitor for potential fouling
Use retrieval line if needed during recovery
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe anchoring in rocky conditions with recovery option

procedures.title: Environmentally Conscious Anchoring
steps: Identify bare sand or mud areas
Avoid grass or rocks with sea life
Drop anchor away from marine habitats
Set anchor with conservative scope for quick set
Reduce scope to minimum safe length
Never deploy on live coral
procedures.expected_outcome: Secure anchoring with minimal environmental impact

procedures.title: Chain-Stop and Snubber Installation
steps: Install chain-stop to reduce windlass stress
Attach rope snubber to chain
Adjust snubber length for proper shock absorption
Verify proper installation before relying on system
procedures.expected_outcome: Reduced stress on windlass and smoother anchoring

procedures.title: Basic Anchor Maintenance
steps: Clean anchor with fresh water when possible
For Rocna Original: rinse inside of hollow roll-bar with fresh water
Ensure oxygen availability to metal surfaces
Avoid storing anchor in damp conditions
Avoid contact with water-absorbent materials like cordage or soil
Store in dry conditions
Ensure air circulation around anchor during storage
Ensure proper drainage of any water
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly maintained anchor with reduced corrosion risk

procedures.title: Galvanized Anchor Maintenance
steps: Monitor zinc coating condition regularly
When zinc coating wears off, have anchor re-galvanized by provider
For Rocna Original: Inform galvanizer about breather hole on roll-bar
procedures.expected_outcome: Maintained protective zinc coating preventing steel corrosion

procedures.title: Stainless Steel Anchor Maintenance
steps: Avoid any contact with regular steel or rust
Keep anchor free from organic materials
Clean thoroughly after use in brackish water
For light scratches: use stainless steel polish to restore finish
For deep scratches: perform re-passivation of affected area
Avoid cleaners containing chlorine or ammonia
procedures.expected_outcome: Maintained stainless steel finish with intact protective layer

procedures.title: Stainless Steel Anchor Cleaning
steps: Clean anchor thoroughly
Apply one of recommended products: Spotless Stainless™, Grunt Emer-Gel™, Wichinox™, or Davis FSR™
Follow manufacturer's instructions for chosen product
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean stainless steel anchor surface

procedures.title: Buoyed Retrieval Line Installation
preconditions: Anchor has retrieval line attachment point
steps: Obtain float and shackle
Attach float to dedicated retrieval line attachment point at heel of anchor fluke
Verify secure connection
procedures.expected_outcome: Installed recovery system for fouled anchor situations

procedures.title: Warranty Claim Submission
steps: Download the Warranty Claim form from rocna.com/lifetime-warranty/
Fill out the form completely
Submit completed form to support@rocna.com
Wait for customer service response
Follow provided resolution steps from customer service
procedures.expected_outcome: Warranty claim processed and addressed by customer service

procedures.title: Contacting Technical Support
steps: Contact via phone: +1-604-940-2010
Or contact via email: support@rocna.com
Or visit website: Rocna.com
Or visit knowledge base: kb.rocna.com/kb
procedures.expected_outcome: Successfully reach technical support

procedures.title: Foul Ground Recovery Mode
preconditions: Risk of anchor becoming stuck on seabed
steps: Attach rode to shackle rail™ slot using stainless steel shackle
If fouled, move vessel over anchor
Reduce scope to 2:1 ratio
Pull anchor backward
Allow shackle to slide to opposite end of slot
Pull anchor clear from new position
procedures.expected_outcome: Successfully retrieve fouled anchor

procedures.title: Secure Anchoring Mode
steps: Attach shackle to secure point
Verify connection is secure
procedures.expected_outcome: Anchor remains set during wind or tide reversals

procedures.title: Warranty Claim Procedure
preconditions: Anchor must be within warranty coverage
Damage must not fall under exclusions
steps: Contact reseller
Demonstrate proof of original purchase
Present damaged anchor for inspection
Receive replacement or refund
procedures.expected_outcome: Replacement anchor or full refund of purchase price
